name: OneMain Holdings, Inc.
summary: OneMain Holdings, Inc., a financial service holding company, engages in the consumer finance and insurance businesses in the United States. The company provides origination, underwriting, and servicing of consumer loans, consisting of personal loans and auto finance. It also offers secured auto financing; credit cards; optional credit insurance products, including life, disability, and involuntary unemployment insurance; optional non-credit insurance; guaranteed asset protection coverage as a waiver product or insurance; and membership plans.
